title: IELTS GT Writing Practice Test 21 — Congratulations Letter
instructions: Task 1: Write a letter of at least 150 words. Task 2: Write an essay of at least 250 words.

questions.letterSituation: Your neighbour's daughter, Maya, whom you have known since she was a child, has just received an offer to study medicine at a prestigious university — a highly competitive programme. Her parents shared the news at a neighbourhood gathering but you did not have the chance to write to Maya at the time.
questions.prompt:
Your neighbour's daughter, Maya, whom you have known since she was a child, has just received an offer to study medicine at a prestigious university — a highly competitive programme. Her parents shared the news at a neighbourhood gathering but you did not have the chance to write to Maya at the time.

Write a letter in response to this situation. In your letter:
• congratulate Maya warmly on her achievement and on being accepted into such a competitive programme
• explain why you are writing to her now rather than congratulating her in person at the time
• wish her every success in her studies and in her future medical career

Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses.
questions.modelAnswer: A strong response should open with an appropriate greeting, address each bullet point in a separate paragraph with specific detail, maintain the correct register throughout, and close with a suitable sign-off.

questions.prompt: University education is becoming increasingly expensive in many countries around the world. Some people argue that students should be responsible for paying their own tuition fees. Others believe that government funding should cover the full cost of higher education. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
questions.modelAnswer: A strong response should present a clear position supported by well-developed arguments, relevant specific examples, and a logical structure including a focused introduction, detailed body paragraphs, and a concise conclusion.
